title: Deepwater Tavern
wikitext:
[[Image:Deepwater Tavern.jpg|thumb|Deepwater Tavern]]
[[Deepwater Tavern]] is situated in the town [[Menethil Harbor]] in the [[Alliance]]-aligned territory of the [[Wetlands]]. It is the hub of a few quests in the area, including [[Quest:The Absent Minded Prospector (5)]], and holds a [[first aid]] trainer as well as a few vendors. Deepwater Tavern is frequently the site of bar brawls, most of which are initiated by [[Tapoke "Slim" Jahn]].
